query: WITH scope_tracks(track_id) AS (SELECT id FROM tracks WHERE availability IN (?, ?)) SELECT t.id FROM search_fts JOIN tracks t ON t.rowid = search_fts.rowid / 4 WHERE search_fts MATCH ? AND search_fts.rowid % 4 = 1 AND t.id IN (SELECT track_id FROM scope_tracks) ORDER BY rank LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
